heading: What the page knows about its host
body: Native hosts mark the body with data-platform="native". The capability manifest (client/manifest.json) still limits the window controls and the browser APIs that need a grant (`tac.browserApis`). Tachyon does not inject (add) a platform, environment, os or target variable for you. To reach its own element, a service injects view. This works only in the browser. The application itself is responsible for native capabilities.
